title: Handout 4A.1 data access, TFR provenance, and tensor alignment gate
note: The gate resolves data-access and coordinate-contract blockers without running decoding or training. TFR-backed LFP remains excluded pending provenance repair; raw LFP, MUAe, and SUA access contracts were validated on a small real-session sample.

claims.statement: The TFR discrepancy is READINESS_STALE+PRODUCTS_PARTIAL: the canonical live D:/analysis/tfr_arrays directory contains four arrays, readiness reports 792, the old D:/workspace/data/tfr_arrays path is absent, and the generator default still names that old path. No regeneration was performed.

jnwb.analog.load_muae_epochs provides a first-class trial x channel x time accessor with deterministic trial_id joins, canonical probe-local area addressing, source series metadata, sampling rate, units, relative time vector, preprocessing state, and explicit missing-data behavior.

A real sub-C31o_ses-230823 FEF QC sample independently validated p2, p3, and p4 omission-relative extraction for SUA, raw LFP, and MUAe. Each modality used the canonical 1031/2062/3093 ms p1 offsets, the same relative time vector, and local t=0 at sample 10.

The access/alignment receipt sets SUA_STAGE4B_READY=YES, LFP_STAGE4B_READY=YES for raw time-domain features only, MUAe_STAGE4B_READY=YES, and T1_ALIGNMENT_VALIDATED=YES. TFR_BACKED_LFP_READY remains NO.

issues: The live TFR product corpus is partial and the readiness table is stale; do not use readiness alone to authorize TFR-backed LFP features.
The live NWB directory contains sub-V198o_ses-230629_rec.nwb, which is absent from the 21-session catalog and readiness inventory.
Only one of the readiness table's 15 sidecar sessions has a live sidecar directory.
The tensor QC covers one session and one area; it validates access and alignment, not full-corpus decoding performance.
No Stage 4B model, positive-control decoder, permutation null, M2, M3, or M4 was run.

verification.verdict: stage4a1_complete; stop before Stage 4B training and request modality-specific scientific review

falsifier: This node is superseded if the live TFR/readiness/catalog state changes, the accessor or alignment contract changes, the QC sample is replaced, or a signed Handout 4 amendment changes the modality gates.
